Name: Kenneth's Mandrake Crop
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Mandrake Crop - Content Patcher[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod adds 1 new crop, Mandrake.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Mandrake grows in spring, summer and fall. It is a simple harvest crop with balanced growth time.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Seeds are sold at Kenneth's Seed Shop.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod is balanced for vanilla gameplay and designed to fit naturally into the game.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Seed Shop[/b][/size]
